```{r}
#| include: false
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)  #zoo is a library to calculate the rolling averages
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
```


First run census_permits_data_pull.Rmd to create the excel file with a table. 

Read in the excel table:
```{r}

#setwd("C:/Coding/housing-permits/2026update")

permits <-read_excel("C:/Coding/housing-permits/2026update/census_bps_monthly.xlsx")

```

Calculate annual averages

```{r}

permits_year <- permits %>% 
   separate(Month, into = c("year", "month"), sep = "-")

annual_df<- permits_year%>%group_by(year)%>%
           summarise(sum_Total=sum(Total),
                     sum_1Unit=sum(`1 Unit`))

annual_df <- annual_df %>%group_by(year)%>%
  mutate(mf_total = sum(sum_Total-sum_1Unit))


annual_df <- annual_df %>% rename(sf_total = sum_1Unit)

annual_total <- annual_df %>%
  select(year, sf_total, mf_total) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(sf_total, mf_total), values_to = "count")
  

## chart showing yearly permitted units by month

annual_tot_plot<-ggplot(annual_total) +
  geom_bar(aes(x=year, y=count,fill=name), stat="identity")+
  #scale_color_manual(values=c("#F05A28","#91268F"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#F05A28","#91268F"
                             #"#A9D46E"
                             ))+
    theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
       panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank())+
  labs(title="Yearly Permitted Units", subtitle="Note: 2026 incomplete (January - August)")

annual_tot_plot

```


```{r}

month <- permits_year%>%
  group_by(year)%>%
           summarise(sum_Total=sum(Total),
                     sum_1Unit=sum(`1 Unit`)) %>%
  filter(year!="2026")

month_df <- month %>%group_by(year)%>%
  mutate(mf_total = sum(sum_Total-sum_1Unit)) %>%
  mutate(tot_month_avg = sum(sum_Total/12)) %>%
  mutate(mf_month_avg = sum(mf_total/12)) %>%
  mutate(sf_month_avg = sum(sum_1Unit/12))

month_26 <- permits_year%>%
  group_by(year)%>%
           summarise(sum_Total=sum(Total),
                     sum_1Unit=sum(`1 Unit`)) %>%
  filter(year=="2026")

month_df_26 <- month_26 %>%group_by(year)%>%
  mutate(mf_total = sum(sum_Total-sum_1Unit)) %>%
  mutate(tot_month_avg = sum(sum_Total/8)) %>%
  mutate(mf_month_avg = sum(mf_total/8)) %>%
  mutate(sf_month_avg = sum(sum_1Unit/8))

month_df <- rbind(month_df, month_df_26)

month_avg <- month_df %>%
  select(year, sf_month_avg, mf_month_avg) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(sf_month_avg, mf_month_avg), values_to = "count")
  

## chart showing average monthly permitted units

month_avg_plot<-ggplot(month_avg) +
  geom_bar(aes(x=year, y=count,fill=name), stat="identity")+
  #scale_color_manual(values=c("#F05A28","#91268F"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#F05A28","#91268F"
                             #"#A9D46E"
                             ))+
    theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
       panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank())+
  labs(title="Average Monthly Permitted Units", subtitle="Note: 2026 includes January - August")

month_avg_plot

```
